name: Shoni the Shilent
summary: Shoni the Shilent is an industrious gnome engineer stationed in Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. As commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew, she directs Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to salvage the power supply of a goblin shredder, fuel for the machines she hopes will break a path back into Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Commander of the Deep
sections.body: Operating out of the smoky workshops of the Dwarven District, Shoni represents gnomish strategic ingenuity far from the lost halls of Gnomeregan. Her engineering plans are ambitious. With Gnomeregan in the hands of the troggs, Shoni is organizing an underground assault to retake it, and she sends operatives into the subterranean tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs.

sections.title: Subterranean Reclamation
sections.body: Shoni's plan rests on the gnomes' own gyrodrillmatic excavationators, heavy drilling machines meant to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan and open the way for a gnomish assault. They lack the power to do it, so she wants the intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. Later, she also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan itself to tear apart its robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.

faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent is a gnome quest giver located in Stormwind's Dwarven District. She acts as the commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew and coordinates subterranean reclamation missions.
She is stationed among the anvils and workshops of the Dwarven District in Stormwind City, near the blacksmithing and engineering areas.

faq.q: Why is Shoni interested in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: A functional goblin shredder works deep in the Deadmines. Shoni enlists adventurers to bring back its intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, so her gyrodrillmatic excavationators can break through the underground borders of Gnomeregan.
The origin of Shoni's epithet is unknown. She is known for commanding the Gnomeregan underground assault crew.

angles.text: For gnomish heroes, assisting Shoni brings their people one step closer to breaking back into Gnomeregan and reclaiming their fallen home.
Engineers can appreciate the sheer mechanical complexity of the gyrodrillmatic excavationators Shoni hopes to power with a shredder's salvaged heart from beneath Moonbrook.
